summary: Console dynamic filter debounce causes trace-link disappearance on dashboard update
description:
Issue summary: When a user applies or edits dashboard filters with quick successive changes (typing + selecting time ranges), the console's client-side debounce and query cancellation logic sometimes removes the "Open trace" links on several heatmap and trace-linked widgets. Impact: Customers lose the ability to jump from a dashboard series to the full trace; some users report missing links on >30% of affected rows for a 90-minute window. Environment: prod, us-east region, console v2.10.3, dashboard-renderer service behind api-gateway. Steps to reproduce:
1) Open Performance dashboard for org/org-122 (NovaAnalytics)
2) Apply global filter: trace.duration > 50ms and start typing a new "service" filter rapidly (type >3 characters, then immediately pick a value)
3) Change time range from Last 1h to Last 6h within 2s of applying the filter
4) Observe heatmap rows and series; hover and open the trace detail.
Observed behavior: Several series display the trace id but the "Open trace" link is missing or the link's href is blank. Clicking sometimes triggers a client console error (see logs). Expected behavior: Trace link should always be present if trace id exists and should open the tracing view.
Logs / client console snippets:
- console.error: "TraceLinkRenderer: missing href after debounce; cancelledRequest=true"
- server: 2026-03-12T09:01:12Z tracer-service returned 200 for trace id xxxxx but dashboard widget received canceled/error state
Investigation notes: Initial hypothesis: debounce + optimistic UI update cancels the link-setting mutation when a newer filter event arrives, leaving widget in a partially-rendered state. Reproduced with Chrome 112 and Firefox 118. Not observed in staging (staging uses longer debounce). Related to a regression introduced in frontend PR #2145 (debounce refactor) which changed cancellation token lifecycle. Query-indexer shows frequent 409s for cancelled query ids during reproduction. Workaround: Users can refresh the page or change the time range again; this restores links. Temporary mitigation: increase client debounce to 600ms for org/org-122 via feature flag (applied and rolled out to 10% of orgs).
Impact to customer: NovaAnalytics reports inability to pivot from dashboard to trace which blocks root-cause workflows during peak load windows. This is classified as high-impact for enterprise customers relying on trace-linked dashboards.
Next steps: 1) Frontend team to add guard to ensure link href is set in the final render pass (owner: @ethan-cole). 2) Backend to ensure cancelled query responses are not sent as 'successful partials' (owner: @backend-observability). 3) Add unit/integration test covering rapid filter/time-range changes. 4) Expand feature-flag mitigation to 100% if immediate fix not available.
SLA notes: First response met on 2026-03-12. Target resolution P1/S1 requires a patch or safe rollback within 48 hours.
